title: Text
description:
A text chart shows the result without a table: each row is its cells joined by
`separator`; newlines in a cell start new lines and long lines wrap. Good for
logs, messages and `lua://` output. See `:help dbdash-charts`.

query.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 12)
SELECT strftime('%H:%M:%S', 'now', '-' || (12 - i) || ' minutes') AS at,
       CASE WHEN i % 5 = 0 THEN 'ERROR' WHEN i % 3 = 0 THEN 'WARN ' ELSE 'INFO ' END AS level,
       'request ' || i || ' served in ' || (i * 37 % 200) || ' ms' AS message
FROM n

show.title: separator, column_list
show.description: `column_list` picks and orders the columns, `separator` joins them (default a space).

query.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 12)
SELECT strftime('%H:%M:%S', 'now', '-' || (12 - i) || ' minutes') AS at,
       CASE WHEN i % 5 = 0 THEN 'ERROR' WHEN i % 3 = 0 THEN 'WARN ' ELSE 'INFO ' END AS level,

FROM n

show.title: highlight, reverse, line numbers
show.description:
`highlight` gives the lines that match a Vim regex a class (the first rule wins),
colored by `line.<class>` rules; `reverse` puts the last row first (newest on top),
`line-number { display: block }` numbers the rows.

query.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE n(i) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 12)
SELECT strftime('%H:%M:%S', 'now', '-' || (12 - i) || ' minutes') AS at,
       CASE WHEN i % 5 = 0 THEN 'ERROR' WHEN i % 3 = 0 THEN 'WARN ' ELSE 'INFO ' END AS level,
       'request ' || i || ' served in ' || (i * 37 % 200) || ' ms' AS message
FROM n

show.title: chart { line-clamp }, line { color }
show.description:
`chart { line-clamp: 5 }` shows the first 5 lines and how many more there are;
`line { color }` colors the text.

query.sql:
SELECT 'A long message that does not fit on one line of the panel wraps at the spaces, as text does in a browser.' AS t
UNION ALL SELECT 'first line' || char(10) || 'second line of the same cell'

show.title: wrap (default), newlines
show.description:
Long lines wrap at spaces (`line { white-space: normal }`, the default;
`word-break: break-all` breaks anywhere); newlines in a cell start new lines.

query.sql: SELECT 'A long message that does not fit on one line of the panel is cut at the edge, wherever that edge happens to be in your window.' AS t

show.title: white-space: nowrap, text-overflow
show.description:
`line { white-space: nowrap }` keeps one line per row and cuts it at the edge
(`text-overflow: "…"` marks the cut; the default `clip` does not).

query.sql: SELECT 'centered' AS t UNION ALL SELECT 'text' UNION ALL SELECT NULL

show.title: line { text-align: center }, cell.null
show.description:
`line { text-align }` aligns the lines (left, center, right); `cell.null { content }`
is what a NULL shows (default nothing).
